meta.title: Roman Quarries of Istria — Geoarchaeological Database
meta.intro: An open-access database of Roman-period quarries documented on the Istrian peninsula: locations, extraction traces and tool marks, geological layering, samples and petrographic analyses.
meta.location_policy: Exact coordinates of unprotected sites are generalised (about 1 km) or withheld to protect them from damage. Precise locations are available to researchers on request.
